Attributed ASTIS-authored compact-source domain integration for fixed PBPS C.1, not the full printed rough B.13.
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel structure and canonical volume, including rank zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C2, 0<α≤β, and α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for all x,v. Let η>0 and βη≤1. Define μ=volume.tilted(−V), J=law(X,X+√ηZ) for independent X∼μ and Z∼N(0,I), ν=J.snd, and S_y=volume.tilted(u↦−V((y+u)/2)−‖y−u‖²/(8η)). Then ν is a probability and there is one dense closable compact-gradient operator G:L²(ν;ℝ)⇀L²(ν;E), chosen before f, with closed closure and exact graph consisting of the pairs represented by φ and ∇φ for φ∈C∞_c(E). For every signed f∈C∞_c(E), let Tf(y)=∫f(u)S_y(du). Both Tf and ∇Tf belong to L²(ν), and their canonical classes satisfy ([Tf],[∇Tf])∈graph(closure G). No compact support of Tf or caller normalization, regularity, Lp or closure certificate is assumed. This is attributed analytic integration of the compact source branch, not the full rough B.13 statement.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let S := fun y : E => (volume : Measure E).tilted
      (fun u => -V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) - ‖y-u‖^2/(8*η))
    IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      ∃ G : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 ν,
        Dense (G.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 ν)) ∧ G.IsClosable ∧ G.closure.IsClosed ∧
        (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 ν) (v : Lp E 2 ν), (u,v) ∈ G.graph ↔
          ∃ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
            u =ᵐ[ν] φ ∧ v =ᵐ[ν] gradient φ) ∧
        ∀ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f →
          let Tf := fun y : E => ∫ u, f u ∂S y
          ∃ hTf : MemLp Tf 2 ν, ∃ hGrad : MemLp (gradient Tf) 2 ν,
            (hTf.toLp Tf,hGrad.toLp (gradient Tf)) ∈ G.closure.graph
decoder_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with canonical volume and Borel measurable structure; rank zero is allowed. V is globally C2, alpha and beta are nonnegative real numbers with alpha>0 and alpha<=beta. The actual directional Hessian has the two displayed global bounds. eta>0 and beta*eta<=1.

Measure.tilted is normalized exponential tilt. The reference volume is canonical; mu is exactly volume.tilted(-V). J is the measurable pushforward of mu.prod(stdGaussian E) under (x,z)->(x,x+sqrt(eta)*z); nu is its actual second marginal. stdGaussian is the standard Gaussian law.

For every y, S(y) is exactly the displayed normalized volume tilt with half-position potential and quadratic denominator8eta. Tf(y) is its real Bochner mean of f. No arbitrary conditional representative or caller law/normalizer certificate occurs.

Lp F2nu is the space of AE-equivalence classes of strongly measurable square-integrable F-valued functions under the same nu. MemLp f2nu supplies measurability and finite L2 seminorm. h.toLp f is the canonical class, independent of the proof witness. Position E finite-dimensional does not make these Lp spaces finite-dimensional.

LinearPMap is a linear partial map with a linear subspace domain. Its graph contains pairs of actual input/output Lp classes. Dense refers to its domain being dense in the entire Lp space. IsClosable means closure of its graph has no nonzero vertical fiber over zero; its closure is the genuine closed extension and IsClosed states graph closedness.

The full displayed graph characterization requires actual smooth compact representatives phi with input=AE phi and output=AE gradient(phi); it is not a certificate supplied by a caller. G is chosen uniformly before every observer f. Gradient is the genuine real Hilbert Frechet-gradient field.

Each f is globally smooth and compactly supported, with either sign and no centering requirement. The statement produces both actual Tf and gradient(Tf) MemLp witnesses and puts their canonical pair in G.closure.graph. It does not assume Tf compactly supported. No separate weak-H1 equivalence, arbitrary rough observer regularity, dynamics, convergence, numerical error or cost conclusion is asserted.

/-!
# The literal PBPS source mean in the actual closed-gradient domain

Source-specific analytic integration for PBPS arXiv:2609.06905v1 Appendix C.1,
its smooth compact reduction and C.2 estimate toward B.13. The original C2
potential, two-sided Hessian bounds, capped positive step and signed smooth
compact observer are retained. Finite real Hilbert spaces and rank zero are
explicit background extensions. The operator is the actual compact-gradient
core on the second marginal of the same independent Gaussian augmentation.

The source mean need not have compact support. Genuine L2 mean and gradient
bounds, whole-function C1 regularity and the uniform closable core are produced
internally. This closes its canonical graph pair only; equivalence to a separate
weak H1 definition, the all-L2 limit, B.13, Gamma, dynamics, main results,
implementation errors and query costs remain separate obligations.
-/

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.SourceMeanGradientDomain

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory InnerProductSpace
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace ContDiff NNReal Topology

noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem literal_source_mean_in_closed_gradient
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ)*‖v‖^2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ)*‖v‖^2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ)*η ≤ 1) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
    let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
      (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
    let ν := J.snd
    let S := fun y : E => (volume : Measure E).tilted
      (fun u => -V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) - ‖y-u‖^2/(8*η))
    IsProbabilityMeasure ν ∧
      ∃ G : Lp ℝ 2 ν →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 ν,
        Dense (G.domain : Set (Lp ℝ 2 ν)) ∧ G.IsClosable ∧ G.closure.IsClosed ∧
        (∀ (u : Lp ℝ 2 ν) (v : Lp E 2 ν), (u,v) ∈ G.graph ↔
          ∃ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
            u =ᵐ[ν] φ ∧ v =ᵐ[ν] gradient φ) ∧
        ∀ f : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → HasCompactSupport f →
          let Tf := fun y : E => ∫ u, f u ∂S y
          ∃ hTf : MemLp Tf 2 ν, ∃ hGrad : MemLp (gradient Tf) 2 ν,
            (hTf.toLp Tf,hGrad.toLp (gradient Tf)) ∈ G.closure.graph := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -V x)
  let J := (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)).map
    (fun p : E × E => (p.1,p.1+Real.sqrt η • p.2))
  let ν := J.snd
  let S := fun y : E => (volume : Measure E).tilted
    (fun u => -V ((1/2:ℝ) • (y+u)) - ‖y-u‖^2/(8*η))
  obtain ⟨hμ,hJ,hν,R,S₀,hR,hS₀,hcond,hSR,hSd,hΛcond,hfst,
    U,hU,hUi,hUs,hBB,hBD,hblock,henergy⟩ :=
    MacroscopicEnergy.actual_macroscopic_gradient_energy_blocks hα hαβ hV hH hη hβη
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hμ
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure ν := hν
  obtain ⟨G,hDense,hClosable,hClosed,hGraph⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.GaussianMarginalGradient.gaussian_marginal_gradient_closable μ hη
  refine ⟨hν,G,hDense,hClosable,hClosed,hGraph,?_⟩
  intro f hf hfc
  let Tf := fun y : E => ∫ u, f u ∂S y
  have hsame : (fun y : E => ∫ u, f u ∂S₀ y) = Tf := by
    funext y
    exact congrArg (fun m : Measure E => ∫ u, f u ∂m) (hSd y)
  obtain ⟨_,_,hTf₀,hGrad₀,_,_⟩ := henergy f hf hfc
  have hTf : MemLp Tf 2 ν := by simpa only [hsame] using hTf₀
  have hGrad : MemLp (gradient Tf) 2 ν := by simpa only [hsame] using hGrad₀
  have hf1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 f := hf.of_le (by simp)
  obtain ⟨_,hC1⟩ := LiteralReflectedMean.reflected_gibbs_mean_c1
    hα hV (fun x v => (hH x v).1) hη hf1 hfc
  change ContDiff ℝ 1 Tf at hC1
  refine ⟨hTf,hGrad,?_⟩
  exact AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedC1GradientDomain.c1_in_closed_gradient ν G hClosable hGraph hC1 hTf hGrad

end
end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.ProximalBPS.SourceMeanGradientDomain
